summary: Iter 52 — Central Catalog Manager NODE CRUD + level-gating + reparent-on-delete + centered modal — all PASS. Backend: 13/13 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter52_catalog_node_crud.py covering (a) level gating: GET /children at root returns L0 life areas with editable=false/deletable=false; GET /children under a life area returns L1 sub-areas with editable=true/deletable=true for super_admin and editable=false/deletable=false for plain admin (core fix from prior 'lvl>=2' bug now lvl>=1); (b) L0 protection: PUT/DELETE on a life-area node_id → 403 'Life areas are the fixed first level…'; (c) role gate on /nodes: plain admin POST/PUT/DELETE all → 403; (d) Node CRUD lifecycle: POST {parent_id: L1_sub, name: 'TEST_QA Test Folder'} → 200 with node_id + level=2; row appears in /children with editable=true/deletable=true; PUT {name: 'TEST_QA Renamed'} → 200 and label updates in next /children fetch; DELETE → 200 and node disappears; (e) Reparent: create L2 parent under L1 sub-area, create L3 child under that parent, DELETE parent (no reparent) → 409 with detailed message, DELETE parent ?reparent=true → 200 with reparented=true/moved_nodes>=1 and child re-emerges under the original L1 sub-area with parent_id=sub_id; (f) Regression: /meta capability matrix unchanged (super=full_crud+store_crud, admin=store_crud only, user=403), scenario create + 409 + cascade=true delete still works, admin can still POST /solution-items with approval_status=approved & is_authorized=true. Frontend (/admin/catalog as Super Admin in 1280×900 desktop web preview): logged in as veales.vedic.decisions@gmail.com / Jelcos@Admin2026, navigated to /admin/catalog, expanded Finance (L0) → all 8 L1 sub-areas (Income, Expenses, Savings, Investments, Debt, Risk Management, Cash Flow & Liquidity, Financial Planning & Goals) now show the +, pencil and trash icons (counts after expand: pencils=8, trashes=8, adds=18 including the 5 L0 add-children buttons). L0 rows correctly show ONLY the + (no pencil/trash). Clicking pencil on Income L1 row opens a CENTERED 'Edit Folder' dialog measured at 460×252 px sitting at x=410 in a 1280-wide viewport (left+right gutters ≈410 each) with Name field prefilled 'Income' — modal is a centered max-width card, not edge-to-edge. Clicking + on 'Physical, Mental & Emotional Health' opens centered 'New Folder' dialog (460×272 at x=410) showing 'under "Physical, Mental & Emotional Health"'. Sheet uses width:'100%', maxWidth:460 + overlay justifyContent:'center'+alignItems:'center' — works correctly on desktop and will collapse to full available width minus 16px padding on phones. No React Native red screens; only harmless 'shadow* deprecated' / expo-notifications warnings from other parts of the app.

issues: Interactive rows / icon buttons (caret, +, pencil, trash, refresh, Verify backbone, Migrate scenarios) and the editor modal inputs/Cancel/Save still use accessibilityLabel only — no testID. Functional but limits Playwright stability. Recommended testIDs: catalog-row-{node.id}, catalog-add-{node.id}, catalog-edit-{node.id}, catalog-delete-{node.id}, catalog-editor-name, catalog-editor-cancel, catalog-editor-save.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID props to row, icon buttons and modal inputs/buttons on /admin/catalog so future agents can automate the L1/L2/L3 CRUD flow click-by-click instead of via accessibilityLabel queries.

(Observation, non-blocking) Super Admin sees a '+' add-child button on L0 life-area rows as well — this is allowed because canAdd() returns true for any catalog_node when can_full_crud. Product confirms they want new L1 sub-areas creatable, so this is intentional, but if you want the 10 life areas to be completely immutable in BOTH structure-of-self AND structure-of-children, you'd block adds on L0 too. Backend already accepts that POST and stamps level=1 — so the current behaviour is consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/catalog_explorer.py — node CRUD block (lines 672-795) cleanly enforces 'life areas L0 are fixed' via level<1 → 403 on both PUT and DELETE; create_catalog_node correctly derives new_level = parent.level+1 and stamps sub_area_id from parent (or self when new_level==1).

delete_catalog_node reparent logic is correct: counts child_nodes + scenarios + solutions and 409s when non-empty unless reparent=true; the $set {parent_id: new_parent} on direct children and catalog_node_id rewrite on scenarios + solutions matches the spec ('lifted up one level'). Note: only DIRECT descendants are reparented — grandchildren stay attached to their immediate parent (which itself was just moved up), so the subtree shape is preserved.

Level gating in /children (lines 179-180) flipped from lvl>=2 to lvl>=1 — exactly the requested fix. L0 still emits editable=false/deletable=false (lvl=0 short-circuit), and plain admin always gets false because can_full_crud=false.

/admin/catalog index.tsx modal styles (lines 629-630): modalOverlay uses justifyContent:'center' + alignItems:'center' + padding:16 + rgba(0,0,0,0.45) backdrop; sheet uses width:'100%', maxWidth:460, borderRadius:16, padding:20, maxHeight:'85%' + drop shadow → renders as a centered max-width card on web and a near-fullwidth bottom-safe card on phones. Looks professional, not edge-to-edge.

openEdit() correctly populates form initial values for catalog_node ({name, icon}) and submitEditor() routes to PUT /catalog-explorer/nodes/{id} with {name, icon}. The L2/L3 pencil-does-nothing bug is fixed at both the UI (icons render whenever node.editable) and the API (PUT now accepted at lvl>=1).

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. The three reported issues are all fixed: (1) L1 sub-areas now show editable=true/deletable=true via the lvl>=1 change in /children; (2) PUT /nodes/{id} actually exists and handles L1/L2/L3 renames (previously the pencil pressed against a non-existent endpoint); (3) the editor Modal uses justifyContent:'center'+alignItems:'center' overlay with a width:'100%', maxWidth:460 sheet — verified visually as a centered card.
